entries.label: CO  32  Dalish Face  1  Female

tags.subject: mirrored under-eye crescents with dotted rays
tags.placement: across both upper cheeks just under the eyes

entries.description: Two thick black crescents arc beneath the eyes from the inner cheek out toward the temples, each rimmed on its lower edge by a fanned row of teardrop-shaped dots that radiate downward like a spoked sun. The pair frames the cheekbones in a symmetrical mask while the nose, forehead, and mouth stay bare.

entries.label: CO  33  Dalish Face  2  Female

tags.subject: short dotted arc plus a leafy branching vine
tags.placement: across the bridge of the nose and down the right cheek

entries.description: A short row of dot-dashes runs horizontally across the top of the cheekbones and bridge of the nose, like a delicate dotted brow-line. A separate branching vine sprouts from below the right cheekbone and trails down toward the jaw, its slim stem sprouting paired tear-shaped leaves along its length.

entries.label: CO  35  Voodoo Face Female

tags.subject: mirrored thorny brow flames and a fanged mouth motif
tags.placement: over both brows and beneath the lower lip

entries.description: A pair of large symmetrical flame-thorn crests sit over the eyebrows, each splaying upward into fang-like prongs and tapering down to a curling hook at the outer corner of the eye. A smaller matching motif of clustered claws hangs just below the lower lip on the chin.

entries.label: CO  36  Corruption Face Base Female

tags.subject: ragged ink mass blotting half the face
tags.placement: covers the left half of the forehead, cheek, jaw and neck

entries.description: A single heavy black mass blots out the entire left side of the face, with feathery flame-like tongues licking up across the forehead and dripping tendrils down past the jaw onto the neck. A thin cracked split runs vertically through the patch beside the eye, like fissured ink eating into bare skin.

entries.label: CO  36  Corruption Face L 2  Female

tags.subject: single clawed tear-streak from the eye
tags.placement: from the inner corner of the right eye down the cheek

entries.description: A solitary curved blade-like stroke drops from the inner corner of the right eye, splitting into a small fang or claw shape on the upper cheek before tapering away. It reads as a single dark tear cut into the skin, with the rest of the face left clean.

entries.label: CO Corruption Face Neck Female

tags.subject: ragged ink patch with rising spikes
tags.placement: low on the left side of the neck under the jaw

entries.description: A solid black blot sits at the base of the left side of the neck, its upper edge breaking into a row of flame-like spikes that reach toward the jawline. The lower edge fades into ragged drips, as if creeping ink were soaking up out of the collarbone area.

entries.label: CO  37  Draco Nordic Face Base Female

tags.subject: twin sinuous S-curves and a small inverted triangle
tags.placement: diagonal from forehead through the right eye down to the cheek, with a tag below the mouth

entries.description: Two parallel S-shaped ribbons sweep down from the forehead, crossing the right eye and trailing onto the upper cheek in mirrored serpentine curves. A small filled inverted triangle sits centred just below the lower lip, anchoring the design with a single chin accent.

entries.label: CO  37  Draco Nordic Face L 2  Female

tags.subject: two paragraphs of angular rune script
tags.placement: mirrored on both upper cheeks beside the nose

entries.description: Two small blocks of stacked angular runes sit on either side of the nose at cheek height, each formed of short hooked strokes arranged in rough vertical columns. The script looks etched rather than brushed, like carved tally-marks scattered across the cheekbones.

entries.label: CO  38  Mitsukami Face Female

tags.subject: ornate winged eye-mask with central spiral pendant
tags.placement: across forehead, around both eyes and onto both upper cheeks

entries.description: A symmetrical mask design with a long teardrop pendant centred between the brows, marked with a small spiral, flanked by mirrored swept wing-shapes that arc out over the eyebrows. Curling spiral medallions sit on each cheekbone with short parallel rays trailing back toward the ears.

entries.label: CO  39  Runic Shade Face Female

tags.subject: dense columns of small runic glyphs
tags.placement: two columns on the forehead, two down the cheeks, and a small block on the chin

entries.description: Vertical strips of tightly packed angular rune-letters run in matched pairs down both sides of the forehead and down both cheeks beside the mouth, like inked verses tattooed in narrow ribbons. A smaller cluster of the same glyphs sits centred just below the lower lip on the chin.

entries.id: CO 39 Runic Shade Alt Face Female
entries.label: CO  39  Runic Shade Alt Face Female

tags.subject: denser runic columns extending down the neck
tags.placement: forehead, cheeks, chin and continuing down the throat

entries.description: Two columns of small angular runes stripe each side of the face, running from the brow down the cheek and continuing past the jaw to flank the throat in longer ribbons. A short block of the same glyphs marks the chin between them, giving a head-to-collar inscription.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Face Base Female

tags.subject: sharp tribal claw mark and a chest band
tags.placement: across the right eye and as a wide band across the lower neck / upper chest

entries.description: A jagged tribal claw-streak crosses the right eye, formed of a hooked horn-shape above the brow and a row of downward-tearing prongs raking across the cheek. A second much wider tribal band wraps the base of the neck and upper chest with the same toothed, flame-edged silhouette.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Face L 2  Female

tags.subject: small flame-prong eye fragment and a narrow chest band
tags.placement: to the right of the right eye, with a thin band across the upper chest

entries.description: A few short flame-like prongs hang just beside and below the outer corner of the right eye, like a smaller fragment of a clawed mark. A long narrow tribal ribbon with toothed edges stretches across the upper chest at the base of the neck.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Face L 3  Female

tags.subject: fine dotwork flecks and a patterned chest band
tags.placement: beside the right eye and along the upper chest

entries.description: A scatter of fine dotted flecks and short hook-marks gathers around the outer corner of the right eye and trails down onto the cheek. A long horizontal band across the upper chest is filled with ornamental motifs of swirls, ferns, and small circular medallions in dense pattern.

entries.id: CO 43 Natura Face L3 Variant Female
entries.label: CO  43  Natura Face L 3  Variant Female

layers.texture: Actors\Character\Overlays\Community Overlays\CO 2\43 Head L3 Variant F.dds

tags.subject: fine dotwork flecks and a patterned chest band
tags.placement: beside the right eye and along the upper chest

entries.description: Sparse dotwork sprays and small hooked marks gather beside the right eye and drip toward the cheek. The upper chest carries a long horizontal band filled with the same ornamental vocabulary of swirls, fern leaves and round medallions stamped in tight repetition.

entries.label: CO  46  High Kraisas Face Female

tags.subject: ornate horned eye-mask
tags.placement: wraps around both eyes and arches over the upper cheeks

entries.description: An intricate symmetrical mask of curling open linework surrounds both eyes, with sweeping horned points rising at the outer brows and curling spurs jutting down past the cheekbones. A small pendant teardrop hangs between the brows, completing a bat- or owl-like masquerade silhouette.

entries.label: CO  48  Faeri Face Female

tags.subject: four mirrored swirl rosettes
tags.placement: above and below each cheekbone on both sides of the face

entries.description: Four small medallions of paired curling scrollwork sit in a square arrangement on the face: two just outside and above each cheekbone near the temples, and two more on the upper cheeks below the eyes. Each motif is built from interlocking spirals and hooks, like delicate vine-curls or fae glyphs.
